`LAR-ROUTING-SysArch` — reviewed **b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01**; drawing/source reference **3fca74b70709345a9440b17cf23acb40aab1f945**.

The scope is defensible as a **standalone matched cooling-pipe experiment**. It cannot yet be described as valid integration with the calorimeter. [Implementation contract](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-routing-dd4hep.md#L8-L74)

- The physical material is the existing **20 mm OD/18 mm ID steel pipe with provisional N2 core**. The 100 mm jacket and cables remain unmaterialised envelopes. Preserve that distinction in inventories, occupancy classifications and conclusions.
- Independently reproduced both routes’ analytic length: **4968.343720697462 mm**. Per route, steel/core volumes are **296561.7305355904 /1264289.482809622 mm³**, with masses **2325.0439674 /25.2857897 g**. Equality depends on retaining the common upstream endpoint and all straights. Replication counts/azimuths must be explicit; station counts do not define a complete cooling circuit.
- The common endpoint at \(|z|3000,\ R2735.3\) lies within existing N2 half-branches spanning \(|z|5–3905\). At matching azimuths, an overlay duplicates existing pipe/core occupancy: old route shares **3000–3905**, new route shares **3000–3300** before bending. This is a continuation/circuit-interface conflict, not additional independent services. [Existing branches](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel_services.py#L64-L69)
- Separate actual pipe contacts from envelope failures. The nominal bare 20 mm pipe clears the maximum H-ring radius by **22 mm** and board-corner radius by **9.6897 mm**. A 100 mm envelope can intersect these occupied bands. Neither conclusion substitutes for native swept-path checks.
- Closed vessel boundaries remain unavoidable interfaces. The old axial path crosses end bath **3910–4017.2**, cold endwall **4017.2–4021**, vacuum **4021–4070**, and warm endwall **4070–4100 mm**. The new analytic S-centreline reaches radial shell boundaries at approximately **3401.1484,3480.4190,3555.2176,3558.4413 mm**. These are probe seeds, not exact polyline contact locations. [Shell construction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel_geometry.py#L282-L307)

Recommended bounded diagnostics: sample the unchanged native context independently at route centreline, steel-wall normal/binormal offsets, joins and boundary-adjacent points. Report bath displacement, duplicate N2 occupancy, closed structural boundaries and empty-envelope violations separately. Include both signs and actual route azimuths; label sampling resolution and coverage. Do not transport through a diagnostic overlay with unresolved overlaps.

The original factory already treats services inside baths as daughters with an exclusive displacement ledger. A standalone world-level route cannot acquire that ownership automatically. Material-preserving standalone results therefore establish the new component’s inventory, not a material-consistent combined detector. [Existing ownership](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/prototypes/calorimeter/LArBarrel.cpp#L143-L165)

Actual checks: verified all eight supplied SHA-256 hashes; inspected pinned material, shell, support, factory and build inputs; independently recalculated lengths, constituent volumes/masses and analytic probe bounds. **No files changed, runtime activation, native checks, delegation or engineering acceptance.** The new route implementation/native results were not present in this reviewed source set.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
App preview maxOutputCharsPerItem=5000; long visible messages may be truncated. Raw reasoning/context/tool arguments/results were discarded in memory before this allowlist stage.

Interacted-with parent/sibling targets are not child-spawn evidence and are omitted from subagents. Native operation counts remain; actual parent_thread_id is retained from verified original thread metadata.
